data.title: Unit 9: Matter and changing matter
Matter and particles
data.text: Current electricity is produced in one place and is directed to flow along a path.
Generation is the process of electricity production in a power plant.
A transformer increases the power of electricity so that it can travel long distances.
In a sub-station the power of electricity is reduced to a level which can be used at our homes, schools, and factories.
During the distribution stage, electricity is transferred from the sub-station to our homes and schools through lines or cables.
